Title: GA: Azure Kubernetes Service mutate default storage class feature

Body.Content:
AKS customers can now use a different storage class in place of the default storage class to better fit their workload needs. For example, the scheduler could use a different storage class instead of built-in default storage class to lower the cost for the targeted scenario.

Learn more.
